title: ExtractionResult
description: The structured result the AI layer (journal/ai.py) returns for one entry. When ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is set this is enforced by Claude via output_config.format with this exact shape; the offline fallback produces the same shape. Consumed by graph.upsert_extraction to grow the knowledge graph.

name.description: Shortest natural name for the entity.

source.description: Entity name (must match an extracted entity).

target.description: Entity name (must match an extracted entity).

reflection.description: 2-3 warm, second-person sentences ending in one follow-up question.
